message: Cross-boundary correctness issue in candidate 181e14238: applySettingsAt sets AppliedNow = (caller <> LocalCli && currentRuntime = afterEffective). With a changed stored value masked by startup --machine-name/--path override, currentRuntime=afterEffective even though no runtime mutation happened; AppliedNow becomes true, contradicting persistence-only semantics. Recommend fail-closed false for persisted-only remote paths (or evidence-backed per-setting actual live effect), add CLI-override negative. W25 composite adapter will force remote AppliedNow=false pending fix; no W24-file edits.
